fortunes.text: A great opportunity approaches. So does its price.
The dragon you're chasing is actually chasing you.
You will be asked to lead. Say yes before you're ready.
The red envelope you receive will contain more than money.
This year, the obstacle is the path.
You will find fortune in a place you've already been.
The lantern you light will guide someone home.
A reunion you've been waiting for happens sooner than expected.
You are luckier than you think. Count again.
The firecracker you set off will scare away something real.
This is the year you stop waiting for the right moment.
The feast you share tonight will sustain you through a lean season.
The fortune you seek is hidden in a number. Look for 8.
You will be given a title. Earn it before you accept.
A dragon sleeps beneath your ambition. Wake it carefully.
The year ahead will test your patience, not your strength.
You will be asked to choose between wealth and peace. Choose peace.
The ancestor you resemble most is watching. Be proud.
A door opens in the east. Walk through it without looking back.
This year, the snake sheds its skin. So do you.
You will build something that outlasts you. Start with the foundation nobody sees.
The fortune you're chasing is actually chasing a version of you that no longer exists.
You will be betrayed by someone you trust. Forgive them before they do.
The wealth you accumulate will mean nothing. The wealth you distribute will mean everything.
This year, you will understand why the dragon breathes fire. It's not for destruction.
You are the dragon you've been waiting for. The fire was always yours.
The year ahead will rewrite your family's story. Be the one who writes it.
The lantern you light tonight will outlive you. Someone will remember it long after you're gone.
You'll eat dumplings. That's the point of the festival.
The red you wear tonight will protect you from something real.
A new tradition begins tonight. You'll be the one who starts it.
The dragon you fear is actually the dragon you need. Stand closer.
This Lunar New Year, you will understand why the firecracker needs the silence. Both are necessary. Both are yours.
